page.overview:
Who is Hundred-Eyed Demon Lord?

The is a demon who once dwelt in Yellow Flower Abbey.

The Hundred-Eyed Demon Lord could pass as a regular human and wore a red cap lacquered with gold, a luminous black robe, a yellow sash, and green cloud-patterned shoes. Beneath his shirt is hidden one thousand eyes growing from his ribs.

The Hundred-Eyed Demon Lord studied the art of Daoism alongside seven Spider Spirits, and eventually became the proprietor of Yellow Flower Abbey.

After being defeated by a group of pilgrims, the Spider Spirits came to Yellow Flower Abbey seeking sanctuary. Coincidentally, the pilgrims also came to Yellow Flower Abbey, and the Demon Lord conspired to poison their tea using an extremely potent poison in his possession.
